GKAccessPoint.doc: An object that allows players to view and manage their Game Center information from within your game.

GKAchievement.doc: An achievement you can award a player as they make progress toward and reach a goal in your game.

GKAchievementChallenge.doc: A type of challenge where a player must earn another player’s achievement.

GKAchievementDescription.doc: An object containing the text and artwork used to present an achievement to a player.

GKAchievementViewController.doc: An GKAchievementViewController object provides a standard user interface to display achievement progress for the local player. If the GKGameCenterViewController class is available, you should use it instead.

GKBasePlayer.doc: A class that provides common data and methods for the different player objects.

GKChallenge.doc: A challenge issued by the local player to another player.

GKChallengeDefinition.doc: An object that represents the static metadata you define for the challenge.

GKChallengeEventHandler.doc: The GKChallengeEventHandler class is used to respond to events related to challenges sent or received by the local player.

GKCloudPlayer.doc: The object representing the currently signed-in iCloud user.

GKDialogController.doc: An object that provides the ability to present the dashboard in macOS games.

GKFriendRequestComposeViewController.doc: Your game uses the GKFriendRequestComposeViewController class to present a screen that allows the local player to send friend requests to other players.

GKGameActivity.doc: An object that represents a single instance of a game activity for the current game.

GKGameActivityDefinition.doc: An object that represents the static metadata you define for the activity.

GKGameCenterViewController.doc: The dashboard that allows players to access their Game Center data in your game.

GKGameSession.doc: A game session you can use to save game data, invite other players, and create turn-based and real-time game apps.

GKInvite.doc: An invitation to join a match sent to the local player from another player.

GKLeaderboard.doc: A leaderboard for a game that Game Center stores.

GKLeaderboardEntry.doc: Information about a single score by a player on a leaderboard.

GKLeaderboardScore.doc: Information about a player’s score on a leaderboard.

GKLeaderboardSet.doc: Organizes leaderboards into logical and coherent groups.

GKLeaderboardViewController.doc: The GKLeaderboardViewController class provides a standard user interface that displays leaderboard scores to the player. If the GKGameCenterViewController class is available, you should use it instead.

GKLocalPlayer.doc: The local player who signs in to Game Center on the device running the game.

GKMatch.doc: A peer-to-peer network between a group of players that sign into Game Center.

GKMatchRequest.doc: An object that encapsulates the parameters to create a real-time or turn-based match.

GKMatchedPlayers.doc: An object that represents matchmaking results, including the players that join the match and their properties that matchmaking rules uses.

GKMatchmaker.doc: An object that creates matches with other players without presenting an interface to the players.

GKMatchmakerViewController.doc: An interface that allows a player to invite other players to a real-time game and automatch to fill any empty slots.

GKNotificationBanner.doc: A Game Center-style banner that displays a message to the local player.

GKPlayer.doc: A remote player who the local player running your game can invite and communicate with through Game Center.

GKSavedGame.doc: An object that represents a file containing saved game data.

GKScore.doc: An object containing information for a score that was earned by the player.

GKScoreChallenge.doc: A type of challenge where a player must beat the leaderboard score of another player.

GKSession.doc: A GKSession object provides the ability to discover and connect to nearby iOS devices using Bluetooth or Wi-fi.

GKTurnBasedEventHandler.doc: The GKTurnBasedEventHandler class is used to respond to important messages related to turn-based matches. To use it, call the sharedTurnBasedEventHandler class method to get the singleton instance and assign an object that implements the GKTurnBasedEventHandlerDelegate protocol to its delegate property. All methods are called on the main thread.

GKTurnBasedExchange.doc: Exchange request information that participants send in a turn-based match.

GKTurnBasedExchangeReply.doc: Details about a recipient’s response to an exchange request.

GKTurnBasedMatch.doc: An object that encapsulates the match data for games where players take turns.

GKTurnBasedMatchmakerViewController.doc: An interface that allows a player to invite other players to a turn-based match and automatch to fill any empty slots.

GKTurnBasedParticipant.doc: A participant in a turn-based match.

GKVoiceChat.doc: A voice channel that allows players to speak with each other in a multiplayer game.

GKVoiceChatService.doc: The GKVoiceChatService class allows your application to connect two iOS devices into a voice chat.

Typically, this protocol is implemented by the object in your game that originally displayed the achievements user interface.

GKChallengeEventHandlerDelegate.doc: You implement the GKChallengeEventHandlerDelegate delegate to control how challenges are displayed in your game.

GKChallengeListener.doc: An object that responds to challenge events.

GKGameActivityListener.doc: An object that responds to activity events.

GKGameCenterControllerDelegate.doc: The delegate that GameKit calls when the player dismisses the dashboard.

GKGameSessionEventListener.doc: An event listener that handles game session events.

GKInviteEventListener.doc: A protocol that handles invite events from Game Center.

GKLeaderboardViewControllerDelegate.doc: The GKLeaderboardViewControllerDelegate protocol is implemented by delegates of the GKLeaderboardViewController class. The delegate is called when the player dismisses the leaderboard.

GKLocalPlayerListener.doc: A protocol that handles events for Game Center players.

GKMatchDelegate.doc: An object that receives connection status and data transmitted in a multiplayer game.

GKMatchmakerViewControllerDelegate.doc: An object that handles when the status of matchmaking changes.

GKSavedGameListener.doc: A protocol that handles events related to saving game data.

GKSessionDelegate.doc: An object implements the GKSessionDelegate protocol to control the behavior of a GKSession object. The delegate is called when other visible peers change their state relative to the session. It is also called to determine whether another peer is allowed to connect to the session.

GKTurnBasedEventHandlerDelegate.doc: The GKTurnBasedEventHandlerDelegate protocol is implemented by an object to receive notifications events for turn-based matches. All methods are called on the main thread.

GKTurnBasedEventListener.doc: The protocol that handles turn-based and data-exchange events between participants in a match.

GKTurnBasedMatchmakerViewControllerDeleg.doc: A protocol that handles when the status of turn-based matchmaking changes.

GKViewController.doc: The abstract base protocol adopted by GameKit view controller classes.

GKChallengeStateCompleted.doc: The player successfully completed the challenge.

GKChallengeStateInvalid.doc: The challenge isn’t valid because an error occurred.

GKChallengeStatePending.doc: The player issued a challenge, but the other player hasn’t accepted or refused it.

GKConnectionStateConnected.doc: The player is connected to the game session.

GKConnectionStateNotConnected.doc: The player is not connected to the game session.

GKErrorCode.doc: Error codes for the GameKit error domain.

GKFriendsAuthorizationStatusDenied.doc: Access to the player’s friends’ data denied.

GKFriendsAuthorizationStatusRestricted.doc: Access to the player’s list of friends restricted.

GKGameActivityPlayStyle.doc: Play Style of the game activity. It can be either Asynchronous or Synchronous.

GKGameCenterViewControllerStateDashboard.doc: The view controller should present the dashboard.

GKGameSessionErrorCode.doc: Error codes for the game session domain.

GKInviteRecipientResponse.doc: A player’s response to an invitation to join a match.

GKInviteRecipientResponseAccepted.doc: A response when the player accepts the invitation.

GKInviteRecipientResponseDeclined.doc: A response when the player rejects the invitation.

GKInviteRecipientResponseFailed.doc: A response when the system fails to deliver the invitation to the player.

GKInviteRecipientResponseIncompatible.doc: A response when the player isn’t running a compatible version of the game.

GKInviteRecipientResponseNoAnswer.doc: A response when the invitation times out because the player doesn’t answer it.

GKInviteRecipientResponseUnableToConnect.doc: A response when the system can’t contact the player.

GKInviteeResponseFailed.doc: The invitation was unable to be delivered.

GKInviteeResponseIncompatible.doc: The invitee isn’t running a compatible version of your game.

GKInviteeResponseNoAnswer.doc: The invitation timed out without an answer.

GKLeaderboardPlayerScope.doc: Specifies the type of players for filtering data.

GKLeaderboardTimeScope.doc: Specifies the time period for filtering data.

GKLeaderboardType.doc: Specifies whether a leaderboard is recurring.

GKMatchSendDataMode.doc: The mechanism used to transmit data to other players.

GKMatchType.doc: The kind of match managed by Game Center.

GKMatchTypeHosted.doc: A match hosted on your private server.

GKMatchTypePeerToPeer.doc: A peer-to-peer match hosted by Game Center.

GKMatchTypeTurnBased.doc: A turn-based match hosted by Game Center.

GKMatchmakingMode.doc: Possible modes that a multiplayer game uses to find matches.

GKMatchmakingModeAutomatchOnly.doc: A mode that matches the local player only with players who are also actively looking for a match.

GKMatchmakingModeInviteOnly.doc: A mode that matches the local player only with players who they invite, and doesn’t use automatch to fill empty slots.

GKMatchmakingModeNearbyOnly.doc: A mode that matches the local player only with nearby players.

GKPeerConnectionState.doc: The state of a peer known to the session.

GKPeerStateAvailable.doc: A peer not connected to the session, but one that the session can connect to.

GKPeerStateConnected.doc: A peer connected to the session.

GKPeerStateConnecting.doc: A peer attempting to connect to the session.

GKPeerStateDisconnected.doc: A peer that disconnected from the session.

GKPeerStateUnavailable.doc: A peer that is no longer interested in receiving connections.

GKPhotoSize.doc: The size of a photo that Game Center loads.

GKPlayerConnectionState.doc: The possible states of a connection to a match.

GKPlayerStateConnected.doc: A state in which a player connects to the match and can receive data.

GKPlayerStateDisconnected.doc: A state in which a player disconnects from the match and can’t receive data.

GKPlayerStateUnknown.doc: An undetermined state in which the player can’t receive data.

GKReleaseState.doc: Describes the release state of an App Store Connect resource, such as an Achievement or Leaderboard.

GKReleaseStatePrereleased.doc: The resource has been created in App Store Connect but isn’t yet associated with a released version of an App.

GKReleaseStateReleased.doc: The resource is associated with a release in App Store Connect. This has no relationship with the “archived” state of a resource (i.e., A resource can be release and archived).

GKReleaseStateUnknown.doc: The system can’t determine the release state of the resource.

GKSendDataMode.doc: The mechanism used to transmit data to other peers.

GKSendDataReliable.doc: The data is sent continuously until it is successfully received by the intended recipients or the connection times out.

GKSendDataUnreliable.doc: The data is sent once and is not sent again if a transmission error occurred.

GKSessionMode.doc: Modes that determine how a session interacts with other peers.

GKSessionModeClient.doc: A client searches for servers advertising the same sessionID property.

GKSessionModePeer.doc: A peer advertises like a server and searches like a client.

GKSessionModeServer.doc: A server advertises itself to local devices using its sessionID property.

GKTransportType.doc: The mechanism used to send messages to other players in a game session.

GKTransportTypeReliable.doc: The data is sent continuously until it is successfully received by the intended recipients or the connection times out.

GKTransportTypeUnreliable.doc: The data is sent once and is not sent again if a transmission error occurs.

GKTurnBasedExchangeStatus.doc: The status of an exchange or reply.

GKTurnBasedExchangeStatusActive.doc: GameKit sent the exchange request to recipients but not all recipients replied.

GKTurnBasedExchangeStatusCanceled.doc: The sender canceled the exchange request.

GKTurnBasedExchangeStatusComplete.doc: All recipients of the exchange request replied.

GKTurnBasedExchangeStatusResolved.doc: The current participant saved the exchange request.

GKTurnBasedExchangeStatusUnknown.doc: The state of the exchange request is unknown.

GKTurnBasedMatchOutcome.doc: The state of a participant when they forfeit a match or when a match ends.

GKTurnBasedMatchStatus.doc: The states of a match from when it’s created to when it ends.

GKTurnBasedParticipantStatus.doc: The state the participant is in during the match.

GKVoiceChatPlayerState.doc: The state of a player in a voice chat.
